summary: An administrator must supply evidence about whom the hospital admits alongside its written admissions policy.
realLife: Federal reviewers requested both hospital census information and admissions policies when assessing discrimination.
inGame: needs: a hospital application with patient census, admissions policy and reviewer findings.

turns.what: The reviewer gets the written policy and asks again for the census.
turns.pulledBy: The application describes admission rules but supplies no patient breakdown.

turns.what: The hospital supplies corrected figures after the field visit.
turns.pulledBy: Its first return omitted one unit.
turns.writesBack: The revised census becomes part of the review file.
